title: Move DriftMergeStore's raw learner_profiles/curriculum_tracks/accounts/stage_definitions writes into DAOs under core/database
rule: DB-1 (Drift mutations only under **/data/** or core/database/; DAO-only writes)
why: drift_merge_store.dart's own class doc claims 'Dispatches each MergeStore operation to the appropriate DAO... the DAO is responsible for the final SQLite write', but for learner_profiles, accounts, curriculum_tracks (both insert+update branches) and the stage_definitions update branch it writes the tables directly instead of routing through ProfileDao/TrackDao/StageDao — and the file lives in core/sync/merge/, not core/database/ or a feature **/data/** layer. DB-1's own rationale is single-source-of-truth: any non-sync code path that also writes these same tables (e.g. profile-edit or track-activation screens) now has a second, divergent write path that can silently apply different validation/defaults than the sync path's inline logic.
recommendation: Add/extend DAO methods (e.g. ProfileDao.upsertFromRemote, TrackDao.upsertFromRemote) so drift_merge_store.dart calls a DAO for every entity kind, matching what it already does for bookmark/profile_program/learning_order/stage insert.
acceptance_criteria: DB-1 audit grep for direct `_db.into(`/`_db.update(` calls returns zero hits inside lib/core/sync/merge/.
drift_merge_store_test.dart's existing assertions pass unchanged (behavior-preserving refactor).

corrections: Strengthened, not corrected: grep confirms a genuine second production write path already exists for learner_profiles (ProfileDao.insertProfile/updateProfile via features/profiles) and TrackDao.upsertFromSync is a ready-made, tested, but production-dead DAO method — the exact fix the recommendation asks for already exists and is merely unused.
